title: Slow Cooked Pork Knuckle Thai Curry
description: A flavorful and tender dish that combines the rich flavors of Thai cuisine with the slow-cooked goodness of pork knuckle. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large bowl over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger, cook until fragrant.
Add curry paste, cook for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice. Stir well.
Add the pork knuckle, cover the bowl and cook on low heat for 2 hours.
Increase heat to medium-high, cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pork from the sauce, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with the remaining sauce and garnish with fresh herbs.
